name: 连理一线

No closed loop, infinity, maze, square enclosing frame, full typeset word or pixel tiles. Palette: Black-violet single structural line, one short acid-lime segment integrated into its final turn. Medium visual weight with generous white cuts, crisp vector-like flat artwork. No mockup, decorative illustration, texture, 3D, shadows, global rainbow wash, generic stock icon, business-icon collage or copied established logo.
